_comment: Tracked inputs of tools/extract/extract_gate_sounds.py (docs/progress/gate-sounds.md). clips: per Arena gate clip (by its AudioClip name) how the client may shorten it to the port's door timing and whether the extractor bakes the authored pitch. mode body_cut = the client may remove ONE stationary stretch of the clip between body[0] and body[1] seconds (equal-power crossfade, head, impact and tail untouched) so that the end event (the thunk or bang that marks the end of the motion, event_s seconds into the clip) lands about when the shortened motion ends; mode as_is = never cut (an impulse-like or very short clip). event_s and body are analysis numbers measured on the decoded clips (envelope and transient scan, 2026-10-25), not Arena data. bake_pitch = the clip is resampled by this factor when it is extracted (AirPit's passport and bus-door players play their clip at pitch 1.25 / 1.2): the shipped bytes are then no copy of the clip, which for the passport clip lives in sharedassets28.resource, a stage-2 key-source file of arena_airpit (docs/PLAN-ENCRYPTION.md section 6). borrowed_rows: sound rows for gates that Arena authors a motion for in the port but no emitter: the row copies its lender's sound and puts the emitter at the same offset from the door origin. map_clips: the entry of a clip on ONE map, which wins over clips for that map (Iceberg, 2026-10-30: all six of its players play at pitch 1.15, so all three of its clips are baked, and the motor gate plays Equator's slide clip, which Equator plays at pitch 1.0: the same clip name with another bake_pitch; event_s and body of a baked clip are measured on the BAKED clip, 50 ms level envelope, 10 ms transient scan and per-50-ms centroid on 2026-10-30: arena_san_gates_blue has its last, loudest bump at 2.45 to 2.60 s, arena_san_gates_red a 100 ms spike at 5.15 s, the baked slide clip its bang from 2.48 s; the intermediate bumps of the first two (1.70 and 2.20 s blue, 3.5 s red) fall near the stops of the shorter leaves, which is an inference, and stay inside the body). Autoservice (2026-11-11, map_clips.arena_autoservice: its four clips are its own, authored pitch 1.0 everywhere, so no bake; same measurements, 20 ms levels around each event): indoor_left has its end bang at 6.40 s (-33 to -18 dB within 40 ms), indoor_right at 6.28 s (-32 to -16 dB), outdoor_left a 7 dB step at 6.88 s after which the motion sound fades out by 7.0 s (no bang), outdoor_right a clunk from 3.05 s that is over by 3.3 s; every body starts at 0.9 s (after the opening transient) and ends 0.15 to 0.30 s before the event. Arena's own drives are longer than these sounds (8.0 s against 6.9 s, 4.5 s against 3.3 s, 6.73 s against 6.4 s) because the clips ease out: the decoded gate progress is 0.92 at 75 % of the big gate's time and 0.99 at 75 % of the shutter's, so the sounds follow the effective motion, not the clip length (inferred, not listened to).
